title: Record one signed n=8 parity prefix at 3/2 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

For the `n = 8` symbol `(1, 3/8, -1/8, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)`, every proper prefix has infinity norm at most `3/2`. The largest is `3/2`. The right shear alone is `731/512`. This is the signed step left open by #4704. The branch is from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

The tail `l1` is `1/2`. The schedule applies the right shear, then the even child, then the Schur child, then the left shear, and repeats that order inside every child. There are 22 factors and 21 proper prefixes. The quotient is `(3/8, 3/64, 3/512, 3/4096)`. The higher signs have flipped relative to the positive even entry, and the absolute row sum is unchanged: `1 + 3/8 + 3/64 + 3/512 = 731/512`. The next nontrivial factor is the even child's right shear, with entry `-1/8`. From there, the other 20 proper prefixes have infinity norm `3/2`. The product of the 22 factors equals the even/odd reordering of the Toeplitz matrix.

`731/512 < 3/2 < 9/4`. The sign change does not raise a proper prefix above the one-level cap. The Schur child does change: it is `(1, -17/64, -9/512, -9/4096)`. The even child is `(1, -1/8, 0, 0)`. Eight nontrivial factors sit in the proper prefixes.

This is one symbol. It does not bound every tail of `l1` at most `1/2`, the generator-shear compiler, the completed Gaussian stage, or the dyadic `p^100` normalizer. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_TRIANGULAR_PARITY_SIGNED_EIGHTH` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetches at 2026-10-22T16:54:11Z, 2026-10-22T16:56:27Z, and the pre-submit fetch at 2026-10-22T16:56:40Z were that commit. The pinned blobs of `certificates/selected-result.json` (`c35482cd9035843b15a634cc8276a7e1e40e8395`), `GAUSSIAN.md` (`adfb28c93e6b06178c901caaac39ede41a9e541b`), and `vendor/SHALLOW-TOEPLITZ.md` (`bc4349b2daea548ffa09e1f38a31f1df86b0b7be`) were unchanged. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
